family.description: Surface lipoprotein assembly modifier (Slam) is a surface lipoprotein that may have a role in virulence [[cite:PUB00095100]]. In Neisseria, it is required for the surface display of lipidated virulence factors [[cite:PUB00095101]]. Proteins in this family contain an eight-stranded beta-barrel domain [[cite:PUB00095100]].
family.name: Surface lipoprotein assembly modifier
